SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ir.inspection_route_id) count FROM inspection_route ir LEFT JOIN inspection_route_point_rel irpr ON irpr.inspection_route_id = ir.inspection_route_id LEFT JOIN inspection_point ip ON ip.inspection_id = irpr.inspection_id WHERE ir.status_cd = '0' AND irpr.status_cd = '0' AND ip.status_cd = '0'
AND ir.community_id = #{communityId}
AND ir.route_name LIKE concat('%',#{routeName},'%')
AND ip.inspection_name LIKE concat('%',#{inspectionName},'%')
